description: This file implements a monitor for the Zalouser provider, handling message processing, session management, and communication with the Zalo platform. It includes functions for message handling, session key resolution, permission checks, and provider lifecycle management.

methods.name: normalizeZalouserEntry
methods.description: Removes 'zalouser' or 'zlu' prefix from an entry and trims whitespace.

methods.name: buildNameIndex
methods.description: Builds a case-insensitive index of items by name.

methods.name: resolveUserAllowlistEntries
methods.description: Resolves user allowlist entries to IDs and mappings, handling numeric IDs and name lookups.

methods.name: resolveInboundQueueKey
methods.description: Generates a queue key based on message thread or sender ID for inbound message processing.

methods.name: resolveZalouserDmSessionScope
methods.description: Determines the DM session scope based on configuration.

methods.name: resolveZalouserInboundSessionKey
methods.description: Builds a session key for inbound messages, considering legacy and current session states.

methods.name: logVerbose
methods.description: Logs verbose messages if verbose logging is enabled.

methods.name: isSenderAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a sender ID is allowed based on the allowlist.

methods.name: resolveGroupRequireMention
methods.description: Determines if a group requires explicit mention based on group policies.

methods.name: sendZalouserDeliveryAcks
methods.description: Sends delivery and seen acknowledgments for a message.

methods.name: processMessage
methods.description: Processes an inbound message, handling permissions, session management, and reply dispatch.

methods.name: deliverZalouserReply
methods.description: Delivers a reply message, handling markdown conversion and chunking.

methods.name: monitorZalouserProvider
methods.description: Main function to monitor Zalouser provider, managing message listening, session state, and message processing.
